New

Song mode: JAM, TAKE and LOCK

HOME › JAM · TAKE · ARRANGE

Build a song by playing: switch which sequence (A, B, C or D) each track plays, record it as a take, then play over it.

How to use it
  1. On JAM, press PLAY. The keys pick A–D for every track; OCT+ launches, OCT- stops.
  2. REC records a take from the next bar. Switch sequences while it plays; REC again ends it.
  3. With K4 LOCK the take plays by itself and you can play over it: what you play is marked YOU.
  4. In LOCK, pick a track and press REC to redo just that track for one round. OCT- undoes that round.
TAKE
  • K1 picks a change, K2 moves it, K3 changes its sequence, K4 the bars.
  • OCT+ adds a change, OCT- deletes it.
  • At the bottom of the screen a line always tells you what you can do right now.
New

STEP FX: play step components live

SEQ › STEP FX (COMP / COMP 2)

The keys play step components while held (stutters, ratchets, arpeggios, octaves), and with REC they are written into the sequence with their value and duration.

How to use it
  • The PRESETS knob picks the step you edit.
  • Hold a white key: the component plays from the next step. Let go and the sequence comes back.
  • With REC + PLAY, what you hold is written into the step where you started, with its length. If the step already has a component, the new one goes into the second slot (they add up).
What each key plays
KeysComponent
1–3STUTTER, /2, /4
4–7RATCHET x2, x3, x4, x8
8–10ARP UP, DOWN, UP-DOWN
11–12OCTAVE UP, OCTAVE DOWN
13–16RANDOM, TRANSPOSE +2, CHORD, MUTE
New · from JIANT BYTE

DRONE CLAY

SEQ › CLAY tab: DRONE CLAY · CLAY MOD 1–4 · CLAY DECAY · CLAY TIME

A per-track sequencer that uses the track's own voice: a very low sustained note (the drone) and four modulators with shapes, euclidean patterns and gestures that move any parameter of the track and even play notes on the scale.

How to use it
  1. On DRONE CLAY turn it ON and pick note and octave. RATE OFF holds it forever; otherwise it retriggers in time.
  2. On CLAY MOD 1–4: DEST (the parameter it moves), SHAPE (drum hits first: KICK, SNARE, HAT…), EUCLID and AMOUNT.
  3. CLAY DECAY sets how long each modulation hit lasts.
Good to know
  • With a MONO or LEGATO voice, the drone yields the voice while a step plays and comes back after. In POLY they play together.
  • A time or pitch punch-in restarts the composition; let go and it returns to the grid.
  • It is saved with the project; old projects open with DRONE CLAY off.
Interface

Always know which track you are on

Each track has its own colour: T1 T2 T3 T4 T5 T6.

  • On top of every track page (EDIT, SEQ, FX, ENV, LFO, MOD, SCL, ARP), a bar in the track's colour reads TRACK N / ENGINE.
  • The same colour shows on the MIXER, on the ECOSYSTEM beings' numbers and on JAM and TAKE.
  • Names are written in full where they fit: ECOSYSTEM, GENERATOR, MIXER, MODULATION, RATCHET, STUTTER…
Changed

Macros that move many things at once

FX layer › MACROS
  • K1 picks the macro (M1–M4) and you keep adding destinations: they add up instead of replacing each other. Up to 16 routes in total.
  • Macros are now mod matrix destinations (M1–M4 in DEST), so an LFO or an envelope can move a whole macro.
  • The punch-in editor opens only with OCT+ on the PUNCH IN page.
Redesign

Effects in HUD style

Every effect page uses the track's colour, a yellow cursor for what is sounding, and thermal cells.

DELAY · Tunnel

Each echo is a frame moving away. FEEDBACK sets the depth, TONE darkens them, WIDE and PING spread them sideways, DRIVE tints the first.

REVERB

The tail as a matrix of cells fading out; the yellow sweep shows time.

CHORUS

Three lines and, when large, an L/R orbit showing the stereo.

SENDS · Columns

CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB and DIST as columns, each under its knob, with its percentage.

SLICER, MASTER, DIST

The playing step in yellow, the meter in cells, the curve in the track's colour.

Redesign

More pages, clearer

MIXER · HUD channels

Number in the track's colour, VU meter in cells, a yellow fader with dB, pan as a dot. The selected track gets yellow corners.

ENV · Layers

The envelope in front and the last notes' envelopes behind it, by velocity. Each stage shows its value next to A, D, S, R.

LFO · Satellite

A yellow dot orbits at the LFO's phase and writes the wave to its right.

EDIT › FOCUS

The chosen parameter large, with a thermal bar; if a modulation moves it, you see how much.

ARRANGE and GENERATOR

"Living score": each section as wide as its bars, one row per track in its colour, a letter only where a track changes.

Redesign

Scales and chords you can read

SCL › KEY

The scale's full name large (D MAJOR, A DORIAN), its notes as coloured chips and the keyboard with each note's degree.

SCL › CHORD

The chord actually sounding (C# MIN7), two octaves with its intervals (R, -3, 5, -7…) and the seven degrees with their type. On a DRUM track it tells you chords play on synth tracks.

Interface

Banners and hints

  • While you hold a key on STEP FX or the punch-ins, a big banner says what it does and which key it is. It goes 0.6 s after you let go.
  • On JAM and TAKE a line tells you what you can do at each moment.
  • All hints turn off in MENU › DISPLAY › HELP OFF.
  • New in the menu: MENU › DISPLAY › PRESETS: SCROLL loads the sound as you turn; MENU opens the list first.
Power-on and sound

When you switch it on

  • New "Six threads" animation: the six track colours come in from the edges and the signature writes itself with a smooth stroke. The version shows from the first frame.
  • No more loud click at power-on: the output is enabled after a moment of silence and the volume fades in.
To make room

What's gone

The device has little memory; to fit the new features some functions left. Your old projects still open: that data is kept but not used.

  • GLO › LIVE (KEYS, RAILS): song mode and STEP FX play live now.
  • SEQ › STRETCH and MUTATE.
  • The sequence dice (SEQ + SELECT). The sound dice (EDIT + SELECT) stays.
  • GLO › GLOBAL COMP: PUNCH SEQ, a punch-in sequencer, is coming.
  • ENV › TRACKS (all six envelopes together).
  • The one-time teaching hints.

If something doesn't work as expected, V10.7.81 is still in the installer.
